variants.title: Ultrasonic ranging in a cold room at 5 degC
variants.unknown: the distance of an unknown target in cold air
variants.note: Sound is slower in cold air, c = 331.3 sqrt(1 + 5/273.15) = 334.2 m/s, so the same distance gives a longer echo time.

source.title: Speed of sound in air c = 331.3 sqrt(1 + T/273.15) m/s (ideal-gas relation, standard textbook)

variants.title: Ultrasonic ranging on a hot day at 35 degC
variants.unknown: the distance of an unknown target in warm air
variants.note: Sound is faster in warm air, c = 331.3 sqrt(1 + 35/273.15) = 352.2 m/s; the same line calibrates the instrument for the day's temperature.

source.title: Speed of sound in air c = 331.3 sqrt(1 + T/273.15) m/s (ideal-gas relation, standard textbook)
